steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each cost centre is placed against its approved headcount, and each open role by its requisition.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 cost centre is over approved headcount

findings.title: Cost centre over approved headcount with no approval
findings.fix: Get the approval or reduce the headcount

example:

pros: Checks a cost centre over approved headcount with no approval reference, and an open role with no requisition.
cons: Not checked: Whether the roles are needed.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-headcount-plan skill on the records for this review.
